page_title: BRE 1-4 LIV | Brentford v Liverpool 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) latches on to the corner kick inside the box, but his header crashes against the crossbar! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
90+4' One of the players from Liverpool times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+4' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+3' Ivan Toney (Brentford) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. The linesman makes the right call and Brentford will have a corner.
90+2' The free kick into the box finds Ivan Toney (Brentford), who heads the ball towards the left post, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping skills.
90+2' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Wataru Endo (Liverpool). That's a free kick to Brentford.

90+1' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the left side of the goal, but Mark Flekken denies him with a great save.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A player from Brentford commits a rough challenge. Michael Oliver blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Liverpool win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
88' Ivan Toney (Brentford) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick goes way wide to the right. Poor shot!
86' 1 - 4 Goal! Luis Diaz provides Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the left post. 1:4.
85' Substitution. Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) has come on for Sergio Reguilon.
83' Jurgen Klopp prepares a substitution. Conor Bradley is replaced by Joe Gomez (Liverpool).
83' Substitution. Alexis Mac Allister makes way for Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
83' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
81' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
79' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
75' 1 - 3 Goal! The rebound fell to Ivan Toney (Brentford) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:3.
75' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Caoimhin Kelleher has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is brought on as a substitute for Mathias Jensen.
74' Flag goes up against Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
72' Michael Oliver shows the yellow card to Frank Onyeka (Brentford) for a heavy challenge.
71' The linesman raises his flag. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.

68' 0 - 3 Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Mark Flekken is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:3.
67' Today's referee Michael Oliver rightly decides to book Wataru Endo (Liverpool) for his harsh tackle.
66' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
66' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
63' Here's the change. Neal Maupay leaves the pitch and Yoane Wissa (Brentford) comes on as a substitute.
63' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) replacing Mads Roerslev Rasmussen.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Christian Norgaard will be replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
62' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
60' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
59' Neal Maupay (Brentford) is flagged for offside.
57' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post.
55' 0 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) was set free in the area by Mohamed Salah and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
55' Referee Michael Oliver sees the trip by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
53' Mohamed Salah loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
52' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes well wide of the right post.
50' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
46' Ivan Toney (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jurgen Klopp gives a chance to Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) and Darwin Nunez is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Ivan Toney (Brentford) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

45+5' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
45+5' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Brentford in a dangerous position.
45+3' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) smashes a first-time shot a goal from inside the box, but it's bravely blocked by a defender.
45+1' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Luis Diaz (Liverpool), but Mark Flekken is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
45' 8 additional min. will be played.
45' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Sergio Reguilon (Brentford), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
44' Diogo Jota is substituted due to injury. Jurgen Klopp gives a chance to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool).
42' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
35' 0 - 1 GOAL - 0:1! Diogo Jota found Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Mark Flekken off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
34' Problems for Jurgen Klopp as Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ryan Gravenberch replaces him.
34' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) attempts to release Diogo Jota with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
31' The game is interrupted now, Curtis Jones (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' It's a weak, uncertain finish and easy for the goalkeeper. Christian Norgaard (Brentford) sends in a volley from just outside the box that goes a few yards wide of the left post.
28' Ivan Toney (Brentford) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
27' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Luis Diaz, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
26' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
25' Brentford quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
25' Michael Oliver interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Conor Bradley (Liverpool). Brentford are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
23' The corner is swung in but Liverpool can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
23' Liverpool take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
22' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Luis Diaz (Liverpool). Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' Liverpool take a short corner kick.

21' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Mark Flekken has it covered and makes a comfortable save. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
21' Ivan Toney (Brentford) strikes a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with an excellent save.
20' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

18' Ivan Toney (Brentford) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Caoimhin Kelleher pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the middle of the goal.
18' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) brings an opponent down and Michael Oliver interrupts the game. Brentford earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
16' Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) commits a foul after dangerous play.
15' The ball finds it way to Ivan Toney (Brentford) inside the box and his first-time shot flies a whisker past the right post.
14' A player from Liverpool commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
14' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
14' An attempted cross from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is cleared.
13' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

13' The ball is cleared after Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
10' The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from Diogo Jota (Liverpool)! That was a huge opportunity!

10' Nice individual effort by Conor Bradley (Liverpool). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom right corner, but Mark Flekken does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
9' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
7' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
4' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post.
3' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will supervise the game today.
